individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Please provide placements for the Civil Department.

content.Placements: In the Civil Department, there are no placement offers in our college. There is no company offers any package in this course. Students do not get internships through the college. The course provides only basic knowledge of civil engineering. The department does not offer any roles to us.
content.Infrastructure: They don't provide Wi-Fi facility. We don't have sufficient labs in our department. Classrooms do not provide a good environment for studies. The college doesn't provide us with hostel facilities. In three years, we have attended only one football tournament in Kurseong. We don't have a sufficient canteen.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Review of Siliguri Government Polytechnic College.

content.Placements: The Civil Engineering course is informative, but sadly, there is no recruitment or support. No campus placements or career guidance are provided, which makes it difficult to find opportunities after completing the course. But other courses have good opportunities.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has a hostel, but it is closed and not maintained. We suffer because we cannot use the hostel. We want the hostel to be opened and cleaned for present and future students. In the future, we hope the hostel will be well maintained. Our college has a Civil Engineering lab, but I haven’t seen it being used.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Not useful for civil engineering students.

content.Placements: Placement opportunities are limited but improving. Mostly small to mid-level construction firms visit for recruitment. College could benefit from a more active training and placement cell, especially for the civil branch. No placement for the civil department.
content.Infrastructure: The campus is well-maintained with greenery and a peaceful environment. The civil department has good lab facilities like survey lab, concrete lab, soil mechanics lab, etc. Some equipment is old but still functional. Regular maintenance and a few modern upgrades would make practical sessions better. Classrooms are spacious, though digital teaching aids like smart boards are limited. All are useless.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Computer Science and Technology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Good teachers and an environment for students .

content.Placements: Basically, in our Computer Science and Technology course, we don't get a decent placement offer. For internships, yes, in our 2nd and 3rd year, we get internship offers from some small companies, but for me, it isn't good. Only one guy from my course got an internship and then a temporary job in that company, but idk the name, sorry. But if you come here looking for internships and placements, then it's not the place for you.
content.Infrastructure: We have a good library; you can take books and study there peacefully. Wi-Fi is also available. We don't have hostel facilities. We have a canteen, but it keeps changing every month, so more or less, no. About sports and games, our college holds some matches for students like football and cricket, and we get to participate in some good games with other colleges and make good memories.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Good technical institute .

content.Placements: Our college carries good placement records. Every year placement prevent is increasing. This year almost 75% students are placed with average package of 2.5 LPA. The highest package provided is nearly 3.8 LPA. Our top recruiters are BITS & BYTES, ELITE INTERNATIONALS, SERVICE ENGINNERING and many more.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has good facilities. Our college provides some awesome facilities such as a full Wi-Fi connection throughout the campus, clean and tidy labs with modern instruments, big classrooms with projectors and a huge library. We do not have any hostel facilities right now.

reviews.review_heading: Good college and teaching and also best infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is decent enough with all the facilities needed by the students. Hostel is good enough and also has the best facilities like wardrobe, attached bathrooms, beds, etc. Food is given of good quality. Menu is chosen by seniors. There are also very less games to play in our campus.

reviews.review_heading: It's a good college but still needs to improve.
reviews.review_text: Good classrooms, Good facilities especially the Anatomy department, Good Library, Hostel, Canteen, and Mess, our hostel is good 24 hours electricity, but no Wi-Fi, bathroom, the washroom is well maintained, and the hostel has restricted timing within 6 PM you should be on campus.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied because of administration.
reviews.review_text: The facilites of hostel, mess, sports mentioned in college website or brochure is all lacking in real. The hostel structure is good with regular cleaning, but there is no proper other facilities like gym, indoor games, TV room, doesn't allow outside food into hostel. The mess food is somewhat okay but not upto the mark. The infrastructure of academic building (classroom) is equipped with good tables, chair, projector, computer, but the classrooms are long (in length), which makes visibility of s...

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely a satisfactory college but lacks patients and has poor hostel facilities.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms are a little good, but the hostels are the worst. They will charge a huge amount from you, but they don't even give basic facilities like cooler or AC, and all rooms are triple-shared, so you can't even think about privacy and a good study environment.

reviews.review_heading: Good teaching with dedicated faculty, good in infrastructure are able to provide maximum facilities.
reviews.review_text: There are total 4 Lecture Halls,  1 Central Library, Each department Has 2 Labs. Hostel rooms are spacious with attached bathroom, hostel also has a gym, recreation and sports room. Various sports tournaments happen at a gap of 2 months. Mess food is good compared to other colleges.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides average infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is average. The food quality is good. There are cleaning staff members on our campus. There are 2 wardens in our college and they are very kind.

content.Placements: Placements are according to what you would expect after BCA. Students have got 3.5 LPA, and 3 of our batchmates got placed in Accenture. Rest are placed in sales companies. There are very less tech role companies visiting campus. Some students still remain unplaced.

admission_process.title: United University Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: United Universityadmissions 2025 are open. Candidates can secure admission to courses at UG, PG and Doctoral level. United University admissions are completelyentrance-based. Admission to courses such as BTech, MBA, BSc, MCA, etc., the university conducts an in-house entrance exam. However, for some law courses, the university conducts a law entrance exam. Candidates seeking to joinUnited Universitycan apply online by visiting the university's official website. Students must also meet the basic eligibility requirements of the programme while applying for their desired course. More details around United University admissions are elaborated in the article below.

United University courses are offered in streams such as Engineering, Management,Law,Science, Medical, etc. Candidates seeking admission to either of the courses need to fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria as per the university's norms. Tabulated below are the detailed eligibility and selection criteria related to United University course admissions 2025:
Know more aboutUniversity University courses

United University feeis a sum of various components such as tuition fee, caution deposit, exam fee, etc. Some of the fee components like caution deposit are one-time paid while tuition fee is paid annually. Check below the total tuition fee for top United University courses:
Note:This information is sourced from official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change.

United University admissions begin with an online registration process. Currently, the admissions are ongoing for all courses. The admission process consists of multiple rounds. Check below the detailed steps around the United University admission process:
Step 1: Application Process

United University application process is conducted in an online mode. Candidates can visit the official website of the university to apply for their desired programme. The application form includes information around the personal and past academic details of candidates.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

After a successful registration process, United University shortlists students based on their past academic merit. Students who fulfil the basic eligibility criteria of the respective courses must appear and qualify for theuniversity-level entrance exam. However, for some of the Law programmes, candidates need to qualify for a University Law entrance exam.
Step 3: Final Admission
After the completion of all the selection rounds, candidates need to pay a certain amount of fee to secure their seats and submit final documents for verification.

faqs.answer: After completing a Bachelor in Pharmacy degree from United University, students can choose numerous career paths within the government sectors. Moreover, to get a job candidates are required to clear competitive examinations conducted by UPSC (Union Public Service Commission), Staff Selection Commission (SSC) and other state public service commissions. Choosing a career in government-related pharmacy jobs in India gives students a stable and secure career. The names of the job roles one can pursue after completing BPharm at United University are: Drug Inspector Pharmacists in Government Hospitals Research Officer in Government Laboratories Pharmacovigilance Officer Government Drug Analyst Regulatory Affair Officer Teaching Faculty in Government Colleges

reviews.review_heading: Best university for students.
reviews.review_text: They provide many technical and non-technical courses to the students. They have provided a well-infrastructured library and 5 canteens under the campus and provide online food delivery facilities. There is a separate hostel for boys and girls, and a 4 times mess facility is included in the hostel fee.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by United Institute of Medical SciencesReviewed on 12 Jun 2025)
reviews.review_heading: The worst college in Prayagraj.
reviews.review_text: They didn't provide any kind of Wi-Fi. During inspection everything was okay and after that, everything was worse.  In summer AC never works. If they find that somewhere AC is working they cut the connection and most importantly during admissions, the exception area is chilled.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty performance is subpar, with low placements. Institute is professional.
reviews.review_text: Constant disruptions plagued the college experiencing frequent power cuts, dripping ACs, and pervasive Wi-Fi/cellular dead zones across much of the building. Food is merely average, and there are no college-promoted games. The library lacks proper air-conditioning, and college gate strictly closes at 9:05 PM, fostering a restrictive, school-like atmosphere.

reviews.review_heading: United University is the best in the town.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is one of the best in the town. Infrastructure provides the required environment for the students to get the best of it through its libraries and auditoriums. There is a huge sports complex which is accessible to all the students whether they are day scholars or hostellers.

reviews.review_heading: United University - BCA review.
reviews.review_text: Surprisingly good campus, and has multiple food outlets, canteen, a sports complex, good AC lecture halls, new library that looks sweet as well. We have United Medicity on campus so I will say we have good medical facilities. Sports are encouraged but not played often.

reviews.review_heading: I'm fully satisfied with faculty nature, and hod is so friendly they will help you with everything.
reviews.review_text: There is good sports infrastructure, including a complex, a track, and a basketball court. The food quality is also good, and classrooms are environment-friendly. The hostel is clean and beautiful, with all facilities available. Electricity is available 24/7, along with Wi-Fi facility. The warden is friendly and familiar, and the hostel management also works very hard.

reviews.review_heading: I suggest that students take admission in this college.
reviews.review_text: BCA is just a smaller course of B.Tech. In my college, there are the best processes. There is Wi-Fi in the college and the library as well as in the hostel. The hostel is good and clean. In college, there is free medical service for students and extra discounts on medicine. We also have a sports complex in college.

reviews.review_heading: Comprehensive review of college, facilities, and curriculum.
reviews.review_text: Our institution provides well-equipped facilities and infrastructure to support BCA students in gaining practical knowledge and skills in computer application. Hostel provides furnished rooms, Wi-Fi, mess, security, medical facilities, laundry, and 24/7 electricity and water.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied with management but infrastructure is good and placements are average.
reviews.review_text: The library is okay. Many times books are not there specifically which we need. They have labs for IBM students. Classrooms have access but don't use them all the time. They are used only during extreme heat. The hostel facility is okay. Rooms are a bit small but fine. The food is bad. Canteens are okay for us. Sports facilities are available.

reviews.review_heading: A small description about the Unitians.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this university is really great and they also provide medical facilities to students in case of emergency as they have a medical college along with a hospital. The infrastructure is good but still, it is under development because great things take time.

reviews.review_heading: I'm dissatisfied with crowd and security. Good infrastructure and average placement.
reviews.review_text: The only thing good about our college is its infrastructure. They have a Wi-Fi facility and good labs. Hostel quality is quite good but currently, they do not organize any sports activities. Behavior of hostel warden is not good and teachers don't listen to students' problems.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty with great qualifications.
reviews.review_text: A smart classroom equipped with a projector and centralized air conditioning is given to us with well-maintained appliances and labs and workshops. Our hostel is also very well furnished with 24/7 electricity and water with clean washrooms and bathrooms. The quality of food is also good. There are three in-campus canteens with undoubtedly good food, and a complete hospital is in our college with free medical facilities for the students. For sports, a separate sports complex is made in which stud...

reviews.review_heading: I preferred to take admission in United University. It provides high package placement.
reviews.review_text: Here in my college, I believe there is much better infrastructure available. And in college, there is Wi-Fi for the students, and good condition of classrooms, smart rooms available, and labs for programming and activities. In my opinion, the quality of the food in my hostel mess and canteen is good and tasty. There is a sports complex and many types of games we play.

reviews.review_heading: Unveiling the true college experience.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is very strong and good-looking. The environment and vibes are excellent. The facilities provided by United University are very good. The Wi-Fi connection and speed are a little bit slow, but the labs, classrooms, and library are excellent. The hostel facility is good, more than expected. However, the mess of food and the environment needs improvement.

reviews.review_heading: A comprehensive review of my college experience.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure of United University are world-class. There are high-speed Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and a library in our college. There are more than 15 labs in our college with all facilities. The quality of the hostel facilities is good. They are much better than others. The food facility is average. Medical facilities are very good. Sports and games facilities are average.

reviews_list.review_title: Real college life often exceeds our imagination.

review_content.Placements: Companies like Macleods Pharmaceuticals, Rusan Pharmaceuticals, NecLife Pharmaceuticals, etc., have hired our seniors. The average package is 1.8 LPA, but the highest has gone up to 3 LPA. Honestly, the teachers and faculty have worked really hard to get the students placed this year, and the number of students that got placed has risen significantly this year as well. The staff also encouraged you to go for pool interviews and inform you of major companies conducting interviews around us.
review_content.Infrastructure: Although the campus is slightly on the smaller side due to there being two campuses, the facilities are pretty good. The library is well-equipped (some books are outdated but still enough resources are available). Classrooms are well-maintained as well. Laboratories have a constant supply of chemicals along with the instruments required for our practicals. Many inter-house sports competitions are held throughout the year. The mess also provides good food (the quality of food, however, varies sometimes).

review_summary.college_name: Sardar Bhagwan Singh University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Agriculture - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: My college is best in other colleges.

content.Placements: In my college and my course, agriculture, the number of students is less, which means 30% of students. In my college, no package is offered. In my college, many students got internships in agriculture at different companies. In my college, top roles are offered, but I don't know because this is my first year.
content.Infrastructure: In my course or department, all facilities are available, which means Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and a library. In my college hostel, the food in the mess and canteen, medical facilities, sports, and games facilities are available. In my college, the facilities are so good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Chemistry, Botany, Zoology) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Exploring SBS University facilities, courses, and student life.

content.Placements: SBS University has a dedicated placement cell with a placement rate of 80%-90% of students. The highest salary package offered is 6 LPA. Top recruiters include major firms like Cipla, Jubilant Life Sciences, Coca-Cola, and many more companies.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has a large collection of books over 50,000 and access to online resources like IEEE and Springer. Modern well-equipped classrooms and practical labs for learning. Wi-Fi is available in hostels. Hostels are secure with CCTV surveillance and 24/7 security. College includes a cricket ground, football field, and basketball courts. Ambulances are available at all time. The college also has badminton courts and other indoor activities.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Real college life often exceeds our imagination.

content.Placements: Companies like Macleods Pharmaceuticals, Rusan Pharmaceuticals, NecLife Pharmaceuticals, etc., have hired our seniors. The average package is 1.8 LPA, but the highest has gone up to 3 LPA. Honestly, the teachers and faculty have worked really hard to get the students placed this year, and the number of students that got placed has risen significantly this year as well. The staff also encouraged you to go for pool interviews and inform you of major companies conducting interviews around us.
content.Infrastructure: Although the campus is slightly on the smaller side due to there being two campuses, the facilities are pretty good. The library is well-equipped (some books are outdated but still enough resources are available). Classrooms are well-maintained as well. Laboratories have a constant supply of chemicals along with the instruments required for our practicals. Many inter-house sports competitions are held throughout the year. The mess also provides good food (the quality of food, however, varies sometimes).

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: One lf the best college for pharmacy in North india.

content.Placements: Almost 90/+ students are got placement Sunpharma, Ranbaxy, Cipla or more companies are there which comes to our college for placement The highest packaged offered in my college is 6 Lacs per annum for B. pharma There are many top role which is offered .
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure of my college or Department is Good. Well-equipped Labs. And library with full of different publications book. And the facilites of hostel is also good. And Wi-Fi facilities is also available and with well greenish ground.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma. Lateral Entry) - Batch of 2017
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied but need to improve in management area.

content.Placements: Management needs to work a little bit more in the management part. There were few companies which came for a campus placement drive but we can not assure 100% placement for students and the company which come for the placement drive are from the marketing background. 100% Placement should be there for every student.
content.Infrastructure: SBSPGI infrastructure is very eco-friendly, there is greenery all around and also the college location is in a very peaceful area. There is no Wi-Fi facility all over the college, not in the hostels also, Labs are well maintained but need to take care of the instruments of the college (especially for the pharmacology labs). Need to modify the classrooms also, very old fashioned classroom and that too with no proper benches, library facility is good, for sports and games there is only a basketball court, need to take care for the other sports also.

admission_overview.college_name: Karpagam Academy of Higher Education Admission 2025: Eligibility, Selection, Application Process

admission_process.title: Karpagam Academy of Higher Education Admission process 2025

paragraphs: Karpagam Academy of Higher Education admissionto all courses, except for BTech and BArch, is merit-based. TheKAHE BTech admission criteria are entrance-based;the institute accepts national-level entrance exam scores, such as JEE Main and NATA scores, to shortlist candidates for admission. For other courses, admission is given based on the fulfilment of eligibility criteria and performance in the qualifying exam. The application process for the university commences online. Interested candidates have to visit the official website and download the application form from the relevant section. Further, candidates need to send the admission form along with the required documents to the official email ID given on the website. Interested students can read the following article to learn all about the courses, eligibility criteria, and admission process forKAHE.

Karpagam Academy of Higher Education offers more than 15 courses viafour facultiesat theUG and PG levels.The courses are offered in different areas of study such asManagement, Law,Artsand Humanities,Engineering, etc. The University also offers acertificate course in Data Science.

As per the KAHE official website, admission to the BTech and BArch programmes is done based on the performance of the candidates in JEE Main and NATA, respectively. Admission to other KAHE courses is merit-based. However, candidates need to meet the eligibility criteria of their desired course to be considered for admission at KAHE. Interested candidates can check out the table below for the general eligibility and selection criteria for popularKAHE courses:

Karpagam Academy of Higher Education feesvary course-wise. The KAHE fee ranges between INR 1.2 L and INR 15 L. Candidates need to pay the course fee at the time of admission to confirm their seat at the institute. Below is theKAHE feeand average package for all courses:
Note: The fees mentioned above is taken from official sources and is subject to change.

The KAHE seat intake for each course is different and depends on various factors such as the number of applications received for that course, the number of specialisations offered, etc. The table below shows the course-wise total seat intake of KAHE courses:

KAHE evaluates the performance of the candidate in the qualifying exam to shortlist candidates for admission to all courses, except for BTech and BArch. Candidates seeking admission to BTech and BArch courses are required to appear for the course-specific entrance exams.

Eligible candidates can begin theirKAHE course admission processby applying to the desired course through the official website. The Karpagam Academy of Higher Education application process is mentioned below:
Step 1: KAHE Application Process

KAHE application processis conducted inonline mode. Candidates can visit the official website of the institute and download the application form. After filling the form, they need to mail the duly filled form, along with the demand draft, on registrar@kahedu.edu.in.
Step 2: Selection Process

KAHE offers direct admission to candidateson the basis of the merit obtained in the qualifying exam. However, forBTech and BArch admission,candidates must have a valid score in JEE Main and NATA, respectively.
Step 3: Result Declaration and Admission Confirmation

After the selection rounds are completed, KAHE releases a merit list on its official website with the names of selected applicants. The candidates are required to appear for the document verification round and pay the admission fee to secure their admission.

faqs.answer: A:    For admission to B.Tech programmes, RKU accepts results from both the GUPCET and JEE Main. The National Eligibility and Entrance Test (NEET), with a minimum needed score of 50%, is the basis for admission to the B.Pharm programme.Results from GUJCET or the RKU Admission Test (RKUAT) are taken into consideration by RKU for BBA and BBA (Hons.) programmes.RKU often takes into account a minimal proportion (typically between 45 and 50%) of your 10+2 board exam results for admission to these programmes. Along with other selection criteria, scores from the Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE) may be taken into account for some M.Tech specialisations. The results of the Graduate Pharmacy Aptitude Test (GPAT) determine your eligibility for M.Pharm programmes. RKU accepts scores from the Common Admission Test (CAT), Management Aptitude Test (MAT), or RKUAT, their own university entrance exam, for MBA candidates.
faqs.question: What entrance exam scores are accepted by RK University for admission?

faqs.answer: A:    The Common Admission Test (CAT), Management Aptitude Test (MAT), and RK University Admission Test (RK UAT) are the three entrance tests that RK University (RKU) takes into consideration when admitting students to its MBA programme through the School of Management (SOM).There is no specific minimum score needed for any of these tests because the cut-off percentiles change annually based on a number of factors, including the total number of applicants, the availability of seats, and the admission exam's difficulty level. Other than the results of your entrance exam, RKU takes into account your performance in group discussions and individual interviews, as well as your undergraduate degree's academic standing and any relevant work experience.

overview_faqs.question: What is Pragti/ Saksham Scheme available at RK University?

The student, if he/she is staying in a hostel, is also entitled to receive INR 20,000 towards a contingency allowance.

overview_faqs.question: How costly is RK University?
overview_faqs.answer: RK University is somewhat constlier than some other universities. The fee of tuition for the various RKU programmes varies significantly. In general, B.Tech programmes are more expensive than B.Sc. programmes. There may also be additional costs for some specialised programmes within a field. For postgraduate courses, tuition usually rises more than for undergraduate ones. Hostel fees are an additional charge if you choose on-campus housing. Depending on the programme and year, there may be differences in additional costs such as lab, library, and test fees.The cost of living will vary depending on an individual's lifestyle and preferences, including food, transport, and personal necessities. RK University provides a range of financial help and scholarships that can drastically lower your expenses.Your financial situation, academic standing, and other criteria determine your eligibility for them.

review_summary.college_name: RKU Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Nice campus, okay academics, and good opportunities for internship.

content.Placements: In our batch, around 60–70% of students got placed through the campus placement cell. The highest package offered is 10 LPA. The lowest is 2.40 LPA. Most of the recruiting companies are Gujarat-based, and companies like Wipro also visit occasionally. Many students received internships in local Rajkot-based IT companies. The common roles offered included web development, data analytics, and AI/ML.
content.Infrastructure: The department has decent infrastructure. It includes computer labs with good internet connectivity, smart classrooms, and a library with enough books for all semesters. Labs are well-maintained, and the Wi-Fi works well for study needs. Hostels are clean, the rooms are spacious, and both water and electricity are reliable. The mess food is okay, and the campus also provides indoor games, reading rooms, and a basic medical center.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Great college experience. Good faculty and campus. Average but worth it.

content.Placements: B.Tech CSE, batch 2025, 85% of students got placed. The highest package offered is 45LPA, the lowest package offered is 4.5LPA, and the average package offered is 12LPA. Top recruiters are Google, Amazon, and Microsoft. 90% of students got internships at Flipkart, Amazon, and startups. Roles offered are SDE, Data Analyst, ML engineer, and Interns, and it is good for placement.
content.Infrastructure: The campus offers Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, well equipped labs, and a rich library. Hostels are decent with basic amenities. Mess food is average but hygienic, and the canteen offers variety. Medical care is available. Good sports and gym facilities too.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Great faculty and campus, good infrastructure, average placements, excellent learning environment.

content.Placements: In B.Tech CSE 2025, 85% of students got placed. The highest package offered is 45 LPA, the lowest package offered is 4.5 LPA, and the average package offered is 12 LPA. Top recruiters are Google, Amazon, and Microsoft. 90% of students got internships at Flipkart, Amazon, and startups. Roles offered are SDE, data analyst, ML engineer, and intern. It is good for placement.
content.Infrastructure: Campus offers Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, well-equipped labs, and a rich library. Hostels are decent with basic amenities. Mess food is average but hygienic, and the canteen offers variety. Medical care is available. Sports and gym facilities are good.

individual_reviews.course: BAMS - Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: Our college is very good, one should take admission in our college, and good environment.

content.Placements: In my batch, there are very good students like above 75%. In my course, if I do a private job salary is between Rs. 15,000 to Rs. 40,000 but if I do my private clinic we earn around Rs. 50,000. We can apply in all hospitals. In our course, we have to do internships for 6 months in college and another 6 months in community health centers. Roles offered are medical officer and doctor.
content.Infrastructure: We have lab, classrooms, Wi-Fi, and library. Our hostel food quality is good but not so excellent. Sports area is also good. Canteen has many food varieties. In our college, mess food is also good but canteen food is very hygienic and tasteful, I would love to eat in canteen.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: It is an average college.

content.Placements: Our college has MOUs signed up with 23 hospitals and more than 50 clinics in Rajkot where interns are given a chance to complete their internship. All the students are recruited as interns and employed based on individual skill sets. The pay scale for freshers is generally low but they can scale up with experience and personal development through various workshops and keeping up to date with current trends.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is good. Our college has well-maintained classrooms, and libraries with all books relevant to our course along with the latest journal editions like Physioforum and research papers. Wi-Fi can be improved. The hostel rooms can be better equipped. OPD is available in the hostel. Various conferences and presentations from reputed members of the medical field are conducted. The hostel food quality is average. Various sports clubs are present such as football, volleyball, cricket, dodgeball, etc. They conduct regular practice sessions and timely competitions.

reviews.review_heading: Nice campus, okay academics, and good opportunities for internship.
reviews.review_text: The department has decent infrastructure. It includes computer labs with good internet connectivity, smart classrooms, and a library with enough books for all semesters. Labs are well-maintained, and the Wi-Fi works well for study needs. Hostels are clean, the rooms are spacious, and both water and electricity are reliable. The mess food is okay, and the campus also provides indoor games, reading rooms, and a basic medical center.

reviews.review_heading: Great college experience. Good faculty and campus. Average but worth it.
reviews.review_text: The campus offers Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, well equipped labs, and a rich library. Hostels are decent with basic amenities. Mess food is average but hygienic, and the canteen offers variety. Medical care is available. Good sports and gym facilities too.

reviews.review_heading: Great faculty and campus, good infrastructure, average placements, excellent learning environment.
reviews.review_text: Campus offers Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, well-equipped labs, and a rich library. Hostels are decent with basic amenities. Mess food is average but hygienic, and the canteen offers variety. Medical care is available. Sports and gym facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is very good, one should take admission in our college, and good environment.
reviews.review_text: We have lab, classrooms, Wi-Fi, and library. Our hostel food quality is good but not so excellent. Sports area is also good. Canteen has many food varieties. In our college, mess food is also good but canteen food is very hygienic and tasteful, I would love to eat in canteen.

reviews.review_heading: It is an average college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. Our college has well-maintained classrooms, and libraries with all books relevant to our course along with the latest journal editions like Physioforum and research papers. Wi-Fi can be improved. The hostel rooms can be better equipped. OPD is available in the hostel. Various conferences and presentations from reputed members of the medical field are conducted. The hostel food quality is average. Various sports clubs are present such as football, volley...

reviews.review_heading: Rk University is having a good infrastructure with a great greenary and also with a good.
reviews.review_text: Our hostel provides us with a nice, clean, and hygienic environment. The food quality is also good. There is a sports club where all the sports are available. Gym facilities are also provided. In case of a medical emergency, ambulance service is available 24/7. The canteen offers a wide variety of food options, from South Indian to Chinese to Gujarati. Everything is available. However, the hostel facilities are not up to par with what we need.

reviews.review_heading: My time and experience at RK university, Rajkot.
reviews.review_text: The college has all the labs required for physiotherapy education, including kinesiology, cardiopulmonary, musculoskeletal, and neurology labs. It also has an advanced research-based course. The hostel has all the basic facilities, including an option for premium air-conditioned rooms. Hostel food is provided four times a day. Given the facilities available, the fees are reasonable.

reviews.review_heading: Best college in Saurashtra region with good campus.
reviews.review_text: There are Wi-Fi facilities available throughout the college campus and hostels. There are 2 big libraries in the college. Classrooms are moderate in size and have airflow. The quality of mess food varies from day to day. Many sports grounds are available in the college but with specific time slots.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with our esteemed faculty members, good infrastructure, facilities, and students.
reviews.review_text: We have smart classrooms, Wi-Fi, labs, machines, a library, etc. The hostel provides facilities like air-conditioned and non air-conditioned rooms, a water cooler, laundry, very good quality healthy food, hospital care, a dance room, a gym, a basketball ground, a football ground, an indoor sports club, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the faculties, facilities provided by the campus and  hoping for good placements.
reviews.review_text: The university offers amazing facilities to support our course, such as classrooms with projectors, integrated computer labs, a library, lecture halls, seminar halls, and active WiFi throughout the campus. The hostel facilities are also up to the mark, including laundry services, physiotherapy and Ayurveda OPDs, a sports complex, a gym and a canteen. The mess food is a bit unsatisfactory but still okay.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied because of faculties, but good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Computer labs, library, and the whole college are equipped with Wi-Fi. Hostel is good, only Hostel B; others are not good. Mess food is improving, and the canteen is good. There is one hospital inside, and two ambulances are available. A sports ground, gym, and sports building with everything you need are also provided.

reviews.review_heading: One University, Many Dreams.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of RKU is very good; everything is well-planned and designed, including the labs, classrooms, and library. Everything is well managed by the staff. In the hostel, the rooms are shared with four students, and there are separate bathrooms and toilets. Each room also has a basin and a place equipped with a metal door for storing personal items.

reviews.review_heading: Facilities and faculties are really good.
reviews.review_text: Campus is clean and green. They give four times food in a mess (breakfast, lunch, snacks, and dinner), and no doubt the taste is really good. In case of sports, they have basketball, volleyball, football, cricket, table tennis, badminton and there are other clubs as well, such as for dance, music, language, drawing, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Our college campus is one of the best in Gujarat.
reviews.review_text:
Library, well-equipped laboratories, departments of all divisions, free Wi-Fi, well-ventilated classrooms, etc. are there. 
The hostel has wholesome food for 4 times: breakfast, lunch, snacks, and dinner.
Laundry facilities, reading room, etc. are available.
Regular medical checkups for ill students are done
.

reviews.review_heading: RKU is good for learning and also has excellent infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: 70 to 80% of students are placed from RKU. Placement is very good at RKU, and every year, students take placements facilitated by the college.

The highest, the lowest, and the average package offered by our course. I have seen lots of seniors completing their internships from the same college and placed in government hospital.
content.Infrastructure: The college environment and infrastructure are splendid and magnificent. There are different labs for different departments like prostho lab, dadh lab, biochemistry lab, physiology lab, and anatomy lab. The hostel is just behind the college takes 2-3 minutes to reach the college. The lecture hall is big enough for a 100-student batch.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Great academics. I am absolutely satisfied.

content.Placements: I am a BDS student at Rishiraj College of Dental Sciences and Research Centre, Bhopal, Batch 19-20. Placement opportunities are decent here, with an average of about 85%. Various sessions for interns are conducted to help them to choose the right path based on their interests. Graduates secure positions in dental clinics, hospitals, private practices, dental chains, research institutions, government hospitals, international dental organizations, and academic institutions. The average salary for a fresher candidate is around 4-5 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: We have adopted interactive whiteboards or SMART Boards for teaching. Our clinics are well-equipped with the latest technologies. Hostel infrastructure has changed a lot in the last few years. Having AC and non-AC rooms with cupboards, beds, tables, chairs, Wi-Fi, and a playing area. There is also a night library.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The college is good for academics. The passing scale is also available. The faculty is knowledgeable

content.Placements: The placement scale is good. Many seniors I saw were placed in many government hospitals, including JK Hospital of the College, and also got placed as faculty in the college. Companies like Pepsodent and another tooth product company came with packages for students for research programs. Overall, college is good for academics and for future purposes too.
content.Infrastructure: The labs are good. I haven't seen the Wi-Fi yet. But I hope it will be provided soon. Classrooms have good infrastructure. Patient flow is also good. There are three hostels: girls hostels, boys hostels, and PG hostels. The food in the mess is good enough. Medical facilities and sports facilities are also provided.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: It is the best college in central India.

content.Placements: Placements are quite good in our college. If you have good academic records, you will get placed in our college. The salary packages are decent. Top recruiting companies are Colgate and Sensodyne.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is modernised. The library is available in our college for students who want a peaceful place for learning. Wi-Fi is available in every department of our college. Smart classrooms are available in our college.
content.Faculty: Teachers are very knowledgeable, friendly, and helpful. Their teaching quality is the best. They conduct internal exams and viva sessions regularly. Non-teaching staff members are very cooperative.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: It provides excellent staff and has great support.

content.Placements: As a BDS graduate, students can pursue 14 different careers including a master's degree in dental sciences, a master's degree in public health, and a master's degree in business administration. The lecturer and clinical practice are offered. It also offered overseas careers as a dentist and government jobs as a dentist.
content.Infrastructure: Hostels are ill-maintained and food is not up to the mark. The buildings need renovation, the hostel mess is unhygienic, and water remains clogged in the sink for a decent amount of time making the vicinity smell horrific. Mosquitoes and stray dogs biting students is a major problem.

review_content.Placements: I’m from the batch 2019-23 B.Pharma. None of my batch mates ot my seniors got placed in any of the pharmaceutical companies. There is a placements department just for the name sake. After passing out, the faculty just forwards job links and walk-in addresses on the WhatsApp group. They provided an industrial training of just one day. They took an amount from students and gave internship experience certificates. Do not expect any job assistance or placements from Deccan School of Pharmacy.
review_content.Infrastructure: As it is a campus situated near a political party’s headquarter, there is no canteen, no play area or play courts. Everyday there’s a chaos for vehicle parking. No student is allowed to stand or roam around in the ground. The college building is spacious no doubt. But all the classrooms and labs are on the side of the busy main road which is full of traffic buzz and honking noise. You will find it difficult to hear what the faculty is teaching or saying. The classrooms are dull and low lighted. Wi-Fi is available in the library. The Library is vast and spacious. There is no hostel facility and no lift for the students. The college has no medical facility, sports or games in the campus. Sports week and annual day are held in Owaisi Hospital and Research Centre’s campus. No inter-college competitions are held.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Dissatisfied because of no placements for the batch of 2019-23. Pathetic behaviour of admin cell.

content.Placements: I’m from the batch 2019-23 B.Pharma. None of my batch mates ot my seniors got placed in any of the pharmaceutical companies. There is a placements department just for the name sake. After passing out, the faculty just forwards job links and walk-in addresses on the WhatsApp group. They provided an industrial training of just one day. They took an amount from students and gave internship experience certificates. Do not expect any job assistance or placements from Deccan School of Pharmacy.
content.Infrastructure: As it is a campus situated near a political party’s headquarter, there is no canteen, no play area or play courts. Everyday there’s a chaos for vehicle parking. No student is allowed to stand or roam around in the ground. The college building is spacious no doubt. But all the classrooms and labs are on the side of the busy main road which is full of traffic buzz and honking noise. You will find it difficult to hear what the faculty is teaching or saying. The classrooms are dull and low lighted. Wi-Fi is available in the library. The Library is vast and spacious. There is no hostel facility and no lift for the students. The college has no medical facility, sports or games in the campus. Sports week and annual day are held in Owaisi Hospital and Research Centre’s campus. No inter-college competitions are held.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: I like its infrastructure and faculty members.

content.Placements: I am still studying here, so I don't know more about placements. Our seniors told us that the average salary offered in our course was Rs. 75,000 per month. This depends on your marks and hard work. We are mostly asked to go for higher studies for better opportunities.
content.Infrastructure: Our campus is huge and spacious. The ground floor and 1st floor of our building belong to hospital management, and the remaining 5 floors belong to the pharmacy. The third floor is filled with functioning labs. We have a library on the 5th floor, which contains all the books related to pharmacy.

individual_reviews.course: Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm.D.) - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: The teachers are qualified, knowledgeable and the quality of education is pretty good

content.Placements: We had to search for jobs, no placements for Pharma.D are provided. For pharmacy, they provide the campus placements and for pharm.D. They have two big teaching hospitals in the heart of the city. 2.0-4.5 LPA is package range offered in out course. Sanofi, GSK and Abott are the top recruiting companies. Pharmacovigilance and Clinical pharmacist are the top roles offered.
content.Infrastructure: The library is average, there is an annual sports week held at owaisi group of institutions and it is pretty interesting. It would be enjoying as other colleges lack in it as the college is in the heart of the city you will save abundant time to and discover the city and create memories.

reviews.review_heading: Best law college in Delhi NCR.
reviews.review_text: Moot courts for practice and experts are invited from outside for the real-world experiences. All necessary facilities are available at the campus only, so we do not need to go outside for small item purchases. Library access is 16 hours a day. We have in house ambulance, our Nescafé and café 14 is the best café we have in-house.

reviews.review_heading: My experience at Geeta Institute of Law, Geeta University.
reviews.review_text: The campus is good, airy, and it is also clean and green, located in a good place with nice surroundings. All labs and the library are well-equipped. Classrooms have smart boards. Food is good here at the mess. Food cafes are also good here. The hostel is fine here.

reviews.review_heading: Fine college and placements.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is fine sometimes it works, sometimes it does not. The labs are also fine. Classrooms have AC in them, and they are spacious. The library is filled with books but its small. Hostel is fine as I heard from the hostellers as I am a day scholar. The food in mess and canteen is fine.

reviews.review_heading: Good experience at Geeta University!
reviews.review_text: As a BCA AIML student, I can say that the course & curriculum are good here & it is running with advanced technologies. They have Geeta Technical Hub, which not only provides hands-on experience but also makes us industry-ready as they are associated with companies like AWS, CISCO, REDHAT, etc.

reviews.review_heading: I am enjoying the vibrant atmosphere at Geeta University.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and amenities provided at the campus were much better than what I observed in other institutes. Rather than just providing the best services, they maintained hygiene on the campus, in the mess, and in the classrooms as well. Here, I found the campus catered to services.

reviews.review_heading: Average, not too bad, and not too good. There are lots of fines for very small things.
reviews.review_text: As I am from the nutrition dietetics department, we have well-managed labs and a kitchen. They provide us with all the ingredients we need for cooking during Energy Week. Regarding the hostel, the food quality is overall good, and we have a unique option for ticket raising if we encounter any issues. We can create a ticket, and that goes to our HoD and VC of the college. They also provide us with the solution. They conduct an open house in which our own head of college interacts with students an...

reviews.review_heading: My overall campus life experience at Geeta University has been positive and enriching.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facility at Geeta University is comfortable and well managed, making it convenient for students coming from different states. All the classrooms are fully air conditioned with smart boards. Infrastructure is high class. The mess food is decent and hygienic, offering a balanced menu with North Indian meals, occasional special dishes and options for vegetarian students.

reviews.review_heading: Appreciate the campus and curriculum.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure at Geeta University is very good with a clean and green campus. Classrooms are modern, very spacious, and well equipped with smart boards and projectors. Wi-Fi connectivity is available throughout the campus. The library is excellent, quiet, peaceful, and well maintained with digital resources, ie e books and journals.

reviews.review_heading: My best time is learning and exploring.
reviews.review_text: The amenities provided by the management were truly commendable. A lot of diligence had been done in maintaining every classroom, lab, and especially the library, which was my favourite. I like to visit day in and day out here. The newspapers-reading area was well-maintained and very calm to sit. The hostel food was my favourite. What I like the most is snack time.

reviews.review_heading: I am really satisfied with the curriculum and college life. I learnt a lot during my internships.
reviews.review_text: Geeta University is automated, from attendance to grades to raising problems all things can be done online. Wi-Fi is available on the entire campus with your personal university id. Rooms and campus are neat & clean. Mess Food is really good and hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: It has excellent core academics with vibrant campus life.
reviews.review_text: I am from the B.Tech CSE course. The most pressing issue is the consistent and low-bandwidth hostel Wi-Fi, which sometimes severely impacts necessary searches. Facilities are clean, and the routine maintenance response time is fast. Common areas are good for socializing, and there are quiet zones or a study room within the hostel. The class can accommodate almost 35-40 students.

reviews.review_heading: Geeta University: A good mix of learning and opportunities.
reviews.review_text: I would rate the course as fairly good. The mentorship is provided by Coding Clock mentors, and they teach really well. The labs are glass labs with 50–60 seats of capacity per lab, and there is fast Wi-Fi in every lab and classroom. However, there is no seminar hall in our CSE department.

reviews.review_heading: This college is allrounder. It provides you everything good.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi was available. Labs were good. Library was excellent, where you could study peacefully. Gym was also available where you could work on your personality. Hostel facility was awesome. I will never complain about this. It was a good budget friendly college that provided you good skills with placement.

reviews.review_heading: Good college, good teachers.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is good, labs are good, classrooms are good, and the library is good. I was a day scholar, but I heard the hostel was good. The food at the mess is fine, not like home, but fine. There are 3 canteens, medical facilities are available, and all types of sports and games are available.

reviews.review_heading: Good college, good hostel.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is fine, labs are fine. Classrooms are fine, the library is good, the hostel is good, and the food is also fine, not like home, but still good. The canteen is fine. There are 3 canteens. Medical facilities are also available, and sports events also happen. Students from other colleges also come.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) - Batch of 2030
individual_reviews.title: All I can say is that if you are getting into this college, please select it without any hesitation.

content.Placements: I'm from the 2024 MBBS Batch. All the alumni are getting the right placement. If you are talking about the internship, then there is Rs. 30,000- Rs. 35,000 per month that a student is getting. During MBBS, they don't give us money. Actually, we get an internship when we pass 4.5 years of MBBS.
content.Infrastructure: Since I'm in AIIMS, it is too good, like anything, for example, infrastructure, management, the equipment related to academics, and anatomy practical. Wi-Fi in the whole campus, and it is too good, 24/7 working. The library is always there for us, enough classrooms, and the CCTV system is also good. All the labs that are necessary in the MBBS course are available in our college. The facilities are too good, I'm getting everything more than I expected. The quality of food is much better. Mess is totally hygienic, so you shouldn't worry about it. Almost all types of sports, like indoor and outdoor, are available.

description: AIIMS, Guwahati cutoff 2025 is available on this page for various accepting exams. Candidates can refer to the exam-wise sections below to view the cutoff details across different rounds and categories. Other important updates are as follows:

AIIMS, Guwahati NEET UG cutoff 2025 was concluded with the release of the final seat allotment result for admission to the MBBS course. The cutoff was released for several categories belonging to the AI quota. For the General AI quota, the NEET UG last round closing rank was 7686 for MBBS admission. Candidates can refer to the table below to view the first and last round cutoffs 2025 for the General AI category students.

AIIMS, Guwahati MBBS cutoff 2025 was 7686 for the students belonging to the General AI quota. Similarly, for the OBC category students, the NEET UG last round closing rank was 14953 for admission to the MBBS course. Comparing both categories, the cutoff rank was more competitive for the General category students as compared to the OBC category for MBBS admission. For other categories and rounds, use the provided filters.

AIIMS, Guwahati accepts the NEET UG entrance exam for selecting students to the MBBS course. Candidates with a valid score are then eligible for the NEET UG counselling. For 2026 admission, aspirants must refer to the table below to view some of the important NEET UG 2026 dates to be eligible for admission.

Candidates preparing for admission can refer to the table below to view or download the NEET UG round and year-wise consolidated cutoff list. This will help students to understand the past three years' cutoff trends.
AIIMS, Guwahati INI CET cutoff 2026 has been released for the postgraduate courses MD, MS, etc. At Round 3, the closing ranks ranged from 793 to 23959 for students in the General AI quota.

Considering the ranks, the most competitive for admission was MD in Obstetrics and Gynaecology, with a lowest cutoff rank of 793. On the otherhand, the least competitive was MD in Physiology, with INI CET 2026 cutoff rank of for admission in the General category.

In the table below, candidates can find the INI CET round- and category-wise cut-off details for admission to various PG medical courses. For General AI category students, the top three most competitive courses for admission were MD in Obstetrics and Gynaecology, MD in ENT and MS in Ophthalmology, with Round 3 closing ranks of 793, 810 and 967, respectively.

INI CET counselling is conducted in four rounds: mock round, first round, second round, and open round. All the rounds of counselling are conducted online. Candidates appearing for admission via INI CET can refer to the table provided below to view or download the round and year-wise INI CET cutoff lists.
AIIMS, Guwahati B.Sc. cutoff 2025 was 2059 in the last round. In 2024, the last round closing rank for the same course was 2156 for the students belonging to the General AI quota.
